claims.assertion: Mari Swa uses alien for species harmful to human-Lyrians and extraterrestrial for people born off Earth, humanlike or not.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: These are her preferred distinctions, not universal definitions.

claims.assertion: Mari says off-world human-Lyrian peoples use familiar tools such as toothbrushes and wheels alongside advanced technology.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says advanced devices do not always replace simple tools.

claims.assertion: Mari says boundaries between humans and extraterrestrials are unclear and describes many listeners as star people like herself.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says she was born off Earth but lived among humans.
